title: How do I report a suspicious call or SMS claiming to be from NovaTel?
content:
Question: How do I report a suspicious call or SMS claiming to be from NovaTel?

Answer: Forward suspicious SMS to the designated anti-fraud short code, or report via Help > Report Fraud in the app with a screenshot. NovaTel never asks for OTPs, passwords, or full card numbers over a call.

Topic: Security & Fraud
